name.en-US: Explanation of the Song of Songs

description.la: Explicatio in Cantica canticorum (Richardo attributa, dubia).
description.en-US: The commentary on the first chapters of the Song of Songs that PL attributes to Richard (doubtful), a work on the soul’s ascent through the exemplars of the saints and the angels to the contemplation of God. Latin only, from the Migne text (Patrologia Latina 196, 1855), a machine-corrected OCR.
description.pt-BR: O comentário aos primeiros capítulos do Cântico dos Cânticos que Migne atribui a Ricardo (duvidoso): a subida da alma pelos exemplos dos santos e dos anjos até a contemplação de Deus.

sources.edition: Migne, Patrologia Latina 196 (Paris 1855); TEI XML of the Corpus Corporum (University of Zurich), text RiSVi.ExInCaC7, from the machine-corrected OCR of the Open Greek and Latin project.
sources.description: The complete PL text with its chapter divisions. PL page breaks and column numbers are dropped, and the PL tables of chapters (which repeat the chapter headings) are not imported. The OCR carries a few residual slips.
sources.tierEvidence: Migne’s Patrologia Latina (1854–1855) prints the medieval text; public domain everywhere.
